description: This file manages the display and creation of dashboard pages for the SuiteCRM platform. It handles user input for dashboard names and column configurations, creates new dashboard page structures, updates user preferences, and renders the dashboard editing interface.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine object used for rendering the dashboard UI.

methods.name: getPreference
methods.description: Retrieves user preferences related to dashboard pages.

methods.name: setPreference
methods.description: Sets user preferences for dashboard pages.
